description: Enterprise multi-cloud regulatory and compliance mandate handbook for highly regulated workloads.
compliance_guidelines_extended: Guideline Clause 10.1: All workloads marked with Healthcare-Restricted classification must enforce rigid data boundary checks within EU geographic territorial borders. ISO27001-2013 is formally deprecated as of January 2026; only ISO27001-2022 certified regional enclaves are permitted. Subprocessor cross-border data transfer is prohibited under Penalty Code 409-B.
